verdict.rationale: Box's developer guide documents creating shared links on files and folders through the API, including an "open" shared link, with configurable access levels. That covers creation with visibility settings. The expiring embedded preview in box-docs-14 is a separate feature and is not credited here. missing for 10: documented password protection on shared links, documented expiry settings on shared links, documented revocation/removal of shared links via the API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
